prerequisites: Knowledge of the following subjects: (496) Business Management

learning_outcomes.text: Know the different production systems and evaluate their advantages and disadvantages.
Select the most appropriate production process in each situation.
Decide the location, capacity, and layout of a production center.
Plan and organize the activities of a production process taking into account deadlines and costs.

syllabus_topics: Nature and context of productive activity. Company system and production subsystem.
assessment_rules: The course's evaluation system establishes that 40% of the grade is obtained through continuous assessment, which includes the defense of assignments and reports. To pass the course, a minimum of 40% of the exam grade (theory and practice combined) is required. If this critical criterion is not met, the total course grade will be 'Fail', with the sum of all obtained assessment grades truncated to a maximum of 4.5 points. Attendance to classes is mandatory, and non-attendance prevents participation in corresponding assessment activities.
